language.title: Language
language.hint: Applies immediately, no restart needed. "System" follows your computer's language.

header.title: Settings
header.subtitle: Account, tenant, cover, and device security management.

data.importHint: Bring your books over from Goodreads, Calibre or LibraryThing: export the CSV from the service and load it here. Duplicates (same ISBN) are skipped automatically.
data.nothingNew: No new books to import: they are all already in your library.
data.exportHint: Download a full copy of your books. JSON for backup and migration, CSV for spreadsheets.

backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: A complete copy of your library (books, shelves, loans, wishlist) in a single file. Covers re-download on their own.
backup.autoHint: On app startup, once the interval has passed. The last {keep} backups are kept.
backup.restoreHint: Replaces ALL library data with the backup contents. This cannot be undone.
backup.notABackup: The selected file is not a Bookeeper backup.
backup.restoreWarning: All current data (books, shelves, loans, wishlist) will be deleted and replaced with the backup contents. There is no undo.
backup.typeNameLabel: To confirm, type the library name: {name}

account.logoutHint: Keeps this device's certificate: you'll be able to sign back in with email + password, no new pairing needed.
account.removeDeviceHint: Deletes the certificate, private key, and tokens. Requires new pairing (with an invite code) to sign back in.
account.logoutOkDetail: The certificate was kept: you'll be able to sign back in with email + password.
account.wipeMessage: The certificate, private key, and session tokens will be deleted. You'll need to pair again with a new invite code to sign back in.

tenant.title: Tenant
tenant.name: Name
tenant.inviteHint: Needed, along with the admin password, to pair new devices (PC or mobile) to this tenant.
tenant.regenerateInviteHint: The old code will stop working immediately. Requires the tenant's admin password.
tenant.inviteRegeneratedDetail: Update the devices that still need to pair.
tenant.adminPwdShort: The admin password must be at least 12 characters.
tenant.mtlsHint: Forces Caddy to reload the trust pool. Use this if, after creating a tenant or pairing a new device, calls fail with {eof} or TLS errors (meaning the automatic reload didn't succeed).
tenant.reloadOkDetail: Caddy re-read the certificates. Try logging in again.

covers.sourceHint: When enabled, the app automatically looks up your books' covers on Google Books (by ISBN) and saves them in a local cache on this device. No cover ever passes through or is saved on the server: the cache lives only here.
covers.autoDownloadHint: When disabled, the app won't contact Google Books anymore and books will show the editorial placeholder. Covers already cached remain available until you clear the cache.
covers.clearCacheHint: After clearing, covers will be re-downloaded as needed (if the option above is enabled).

info.upToDateMsg: You're using the latest available version.
info.idleMsg: Bookeeper automatically checks for updates on startup, at most once a day.
info.checkFailedDetail: Check your connection and try again.

dialogs.rotateIntro: Enter the tenant's admin password to generate a new invite code. The previous one will be revoked instantly.
dialogs.reloadIntro: Caddy regenerates the trust pool from the database and reloads its configuration. No downtime for ongoing connections.
dialogs.bootstrapUrlHint: Same host as the Server URL if bootstrap is publicly exposed, otherwise the tailnet/VPN host.

banner.readyMsg: {name} is ready. The app will close to complete installation.

assign.hint: Click an empty slot to place the book. Gray slots are already occupied.
assign.full: The shelf is full. Pick another shelf or free up a slot.
assign.empty: No shelves yet. Create a shelf first from the Shelves page.

config.name: Name
config.namePlaceholder: E.g. Living room, Study, Kids room…

dashboard.title: Shelves
dashboard.subtitle: View and organize your physical library with interactive shelves.
dashboard.emptyTitle: You don't have any shelves yet
dashboard.emptySub: Create your first shelf to start organizing your books visually.
dashboard.deleteWithBooks: “{name}” contains {n} books. Placements will be removed, but the books stay in the library. Proceed?

detail.hint: Click an empty slot to assign a book to it.

list.title: Loans
list.subtitle: Keep track of who borrowed which book and when it's due back.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, person, or note...
list.emptySub: When you lend a book, record it here to remember who has it and when it should come back home.
list.emptyFilteredSub: Try changing the selected status or clearing the search.
list.deleteConfirm: Delete the loan of “{title}” to {name}? This cannot be undone.

form.bookSearchPlaceholder: Search by title, author, or ISBN...
form.bookHint: Start typing to search the library.
form.dueDateHint: Leave empty if there's no due date.

view.title: Wishlist
view.subtitle: Books you want to read or receive as a gift. Add them on the fly and promote them to the library once you get them.
view.emptySub: Start adding books you'd like to read or receive as a gift. Use the bar above for a quick add, or "New entry" to add links and notes.
view.emptyFilteredSub: Change the priority or search to see other entries.
view.convertConfirm: Promote "{title}" from wishlist to a book in your library? The entry will be removed from the wishlist.

quickAdd.title: Title
quickAdd.hint: Press {kbd} to add to the wishlist; edit authors, links, and notes later from the list below.

editDialog.title: Title
editDialog.notesPlaceholder: e.g. gift for Mark / look for used copy / signed

view.title: Statistics
view.subtitle: Reading, genre, author, and library activity dashboard.
view.emptyLibrary: The library is still empty: add some books to start seeing meaningful statistics.
view.chartAdditionsSub: Books added in the last 12 months
view.chartAdditionsEmpty: No books added in the last 12 months
view.chartAdditionsAria: Line chart of monthly additions over the last 12 months
view.chartFormatAria: Doughnut chart of book format distribution
view.chartLangAria: Horizontal bar chart of the number of books by language
view.chartGenreSub: Top 12 most common genres in the library
view.chartGenreEmpty: No genre assigned to any books
view.chartGenreAria: Horizontal bar chart of the most common genres
view.chartDecadeAria: Vertical bar chart of the number of books by publication decade
view.chartLoansAria: Line chart of monthly loan activity
view.topAuthorsSub: Top 10 by number of works in the library
view.topAuthorsAria: Ranking of the most represented authors

list.title: Devices
list.subtitle: Manage the clients that can access your library.
list.emptySub: Generate a QR code to add the mobile companion and manage your library from your phone too.
list.revokeConfirm: Revoke the device "{name}"? It won't be able to access until re-paired.

pair.title: Pair mobile
pair.subtitle: Scan the QR code with your phone's camera.
pair.localTitle: Not available with the local library
pair.localText1: Your library only lives on this computer ({host}): your phone can't reach it, so mobile pairing wouldn't work.
pair.localText2: To use Bookeeper from your phone you need a library on a network-reachable server (NAS, Raspberry, VPS): see the guides in {dir} of the project.
pair.unlockSub: This is needed only once after a server update. From now on, any user will be able to pair a mobile device without entering a password.
pair.step1: Open your phone's {strong} and point it at the QR code.
pair.step2: Tap the link that pops up: {strong} will open in your browser.
pair.step3: The app pairs automatically. From {strong} you can install it on your home screen.
pair.security: The code is valid for {min} and works {once}. If someone intercepts it after use, it's already unusable.

list.emptySearchSub: Try another term or clear the search.
list.emptySub: Add your first book to start building your catalog.
list.confirmDeleteMsg: Permanently delete {n} book? This cannot be undone. | Permanently delete {n} books? This cannot be undone.

form.title: Title
form.subtitle: Subtitle
form.lookupTitle: Fetch title, authors, publisher… from online sources
form.isbnMissingDetail: Enter a valid ISBN-13 or ISBN-10 before the lookup.

create.shelfHelp: The book will be placed in the shelf's first free slot.
create.warnFull: Book created, but the selected shelf is full: no free slot.
create.warnAssign: Book created, but shelf assignment failed: {msg}

move.intro: Pick a shelf: books will be placed in the first free slots in row order. Books already on other shelves will be skipped.
move.overflow: The shelf has {free} free slots but you're moving {n} books. The first {free} will be placed, the rest will be skipped.

detail.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this book? This cannot be undone.

cover.failed: Download failed — click reload to retry
cover.notFound: Cover not available on Google Books / OpenLibrary

firstBook.title: Your first book
firstBook.body: Grab a book from your shelf and find the barcode on the back: Bookeeper fills in title, author and cover by itself.
firstBook.importLink: I already have a catalog to import

celebration.title: The first of many
celebration.body: Your book is in the catalog. Now give it a home: create a shelf with the layout of your real bookcase.

shelves.title: Shelves are your bookcase, digitized
shelves.body: Create a shelf with the rows and slots of your real furniture: then place books into slots and you'll always know where they are.

loans.title: No more vanishing books
loans.body: When you lend a book, record it here with a name and date: Bookeeper remembers who has it and for how long.

login.brandQuote: "He knew how to read. It was the most important discovery of his entire life. He knew how to read. He possessed the antidote against the terrible venom of old age."
login.welcomeSubtitle: Your home library. Where would you like to start?

path.loginDesc: Sign back in as {email} with your password.
path.loginDescNoEmail: Sign back in with your password.
path.localDesc: Everything on this computer: no server, one single step.
path.remoteDesc: You have a self-hosted Bookeeper (NAS, Raspberry, VPS) still empty.
path.pairDesc: The library already exists: pair this computer with the invite code.

subtitle.local: No server, no configuration: your data stays on this PC.
subtitle.remote: I'll create the library on your server and pair this computer right away.
subtitle.pair: You'll need the library's invite code and admin password.

notice.expired: Your session has expired. Enter your password to continue.
notice.loggedOut: Signed out. Enter your password to get back in.

field.advancedSummary: Is the server on a private network (Tailscale, VPN)?
field.advancedHint: Leave empty in most cases. If it's wrong, I'll tell you on the first attempt.
field.libraryHint: Just a label: you can change it anytime.
field.inviteHint: Find it under Settings → Library on an already-paired device.
field.inviteError: The library's invite code is required
field.adminHintRemote: At least 12 characters. It protects the library's key: {strong}, save it in a password manager.
field.adminHintPair: The one chosen by whoever created the library.
field.adminErrorRemote: At least 12 characters: it protects the library's key

recovery.intro: If you know the {strong}, I'll generate a new one (the old one stops working).
recovery.errServer: Fill in the server address above first.
recovery.errPwd: The admin password is at least 12 characters.
recovery.errCredentials: Library name or admin password incorrect.
recovery.success: New code generated for “{name}”. The old one no longer works.

created.title: Library created.
created.save: Save it: you'll need it to pair other devices.

error.mtlsHost: The server doesn't respond at this address (the public domain is mTLS-only). Open "Is the server on a private network?" and enter the host that exposes pairing (e.g. https://bookeeper.tail22adce.ts.net).
error.pairAfterSetup: Library created, but automatic pairing failed. Retry from here: the fields are already filled in.

login.anotherAccount: Use another account or another library
